regime.label: Risk-off
regime.text: Risk-off. BTC is +0.3% over 24h and +0.0% over the last 3 hours, trading below its 15m EMA21; ETH is +0.2% on the day. 22% of coins are up over 24h (median −1.6%) and 9% have a rising 1h trend. Long setups fail more often in this tape; cut size or wait.

evidence.rule: forward evidence = backtest trades + identity-qualified live trades (entry-time VERIFIED_CRYPTO proof); legacy live trades are kept and reported here, never counted

strategies.name: Smart-money follow
strategies.desc: At least 70% of the money Hyperliquid's top traders hold in the coin is long ($250K+ from 5+ traders, not reduced since the last scan) and price is above EMA50. Buy near EMA21.

strategies.name: Oversold bounce in an uptrend
strategies.desc: The 1h trend is up but the 15m RSI is 32 or lower (or price sits on the lower Bollinger band) within 1.5 ATR of a swing low, and the candle is turning up. Quick targets; stop under the low.
strategies.why: 58% winners, +0.08R per trade, profit factor 1.17 over 128 trades; -0.08R per trade against random entries; 8 of 40 live trades needed for a pass

strategies.name: EMA9/21 bull cross
strategies.desc: EMA9 crossed above EMA21 in the last three candles with +DI over -DI, price above VWAP and RSI 50-72. Buy near EMA21; stop under the 2-hour low.
strategies.why: 50% winners, -0.02R per trade, profit factor 0.95 over 250 trades; +0.10R per trade against random entries; 15 of 40 live trades needed for a pass

strategies.name: Squeeze break
strategies.desc: Bollinger width in the tightest quarter of the day while price holds the top of a rising 3-hour range. Buy only after a 15m close above the range high.
strategies.why: 44% winners, -0.09R per trade, profit factor 0.84 over 250 trades; +0.38R per trade against random entries; 9 of 40 live trades needed for a pass

strategies.name: VWAP reclaim
strategies.desc: Price traded below the 24h VWAP in the last two hours and closes back above it on 1.3x+ volume while the 1h trend is not down. Buy at VWAP; stop under the 2-hour low.
strategies.why: 49% winners, +0.00R per trade, profit factor 1.00 over 156 trades; +1.40R per trade against random entries; stays rejected until it makes money again (profit factor 1.05+)

strategies.name: EMA21 trend pullback
strategies.desc: Bullish EMA 9/21/50 stack with a rising EMA21; price dips into the EMA9-EMA21 area with RSI 42-66. Stop under EMA50 or the last swing low.
strategies.why: 52% winners, -0.03R per trade, profit factor 0.95 over 250 trades; +0.28R per trade against random entries; stays rejected until it makes money again (profit factor 1.05+)

strategies.name: Range breakout retest
strategies.desc: A 15m close above the prior 8-hour range high on strong volume. Buy the retest of the broken high; stop under the level and the breakout candle.
strategies.why: 50% winners, -0.04R per trade, profit factor 0.92 over 250 trades; +0.81R per trade against random entries; stays rejected until it makes money again (profit factor 1.05+)

strategies.name: 24-hour high breakout
strategies.desc: A 15m close above the prior 24-hour high on 2x+ volume. Buy the retest of the old high; stop 1 ATR under it. Wider targets for a fresh daily breakout.
strategies.why: 42% winners, -0.12R per trade, profit factor 0.82 over 250 trades; +0.70R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: Trend continuation (EMA9 dip)
strategies.desc: Strong trend (ADX 22+, +DI over -DI, RSI 58-80) within 2% of the 24h high. Buy dips to EMA9; stop under EMA21 and the last swing low.
strategies.why: 45% winners, -0.14R per trade, profit factor 0.76 over 250 trades; +0.12R per trade against random entries

mistakes.label: Chased: price far above EMA21 or above the zone
No volume behind the move (under 1.2x normal)
No red flags: a normal loss
Stopped out, then price hit TP1 within 3 hours (stop too tight)
mistakes.fix: watched per strategy: a stop widens 10% when 35%+ of its recent stops were hunted

mistakes.label: Bought into overbought RSI (75+)
mistakes.fix: not a real mistake so far: these trades averaged +0.27R vs +0.03R, so they get +3 points

mistakes.label: Stopped within 30 minutes of the fill (failed breakout)
mistakes.fix: counted in each breakout strategy's record, which decides whether it stays published

mistakes.label: Late: the coin was already up 25%+ in 24h

descs.PB: Bullish EMA 9/21/50 stack with a rising EMA21; price dips into the EMA9-EMA21 area with RSI 42-66. Stop under EMA50 or the last swing low.
descs.MOM: Strong trend (ADX 22+, +DI over -DI, RSI 58-80) within 2% of the 24h high. Buy dips to EMA9; stop under EMA21 and the last swing low.
descs.VWAP: Price traded below the 24h VWAP in the last two hours and closes back above it on 1.3x+ volume while the 1h trend is not down. Buy at VWAP; stop under the 2-hour low.
descs.MR: The 1h trend is up but the 15m RSI is 32 or lower (or price sits on the lower Bollinger band) within 1.5 ATR of a swing low, and the candle is turning up. Quick targets; stop under the low.
descs.SMF: At least 70% of the money Hyperliquid's top traders hold in the coin is long ($250K+ from 5+ traders, not reduced since the last scan) and price is above EMA50. Buy near EMA21.
descs.HI24: A 15m close above the prior 24-hour high on 2x+ volume. Buy the retest of the old high; stop 1 ATR under it. Wider targets for a fresh daily breakout.
descs.XOVER: EMA9 crossed above EMA21 in the last three candles with +DI over -DI, price above VWAP and RSI 50-72. Buy near EMA21; stop under the 2-hour low.
